name: Rebuild a website section in your Shopify theme with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a website section in your Shopify theme

Turns a section of any live website into a Shopify theme section and uploads it straight into your theme. Then add it to any page from the theme editor.

**Setup**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key at https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding and add it as a **MiroMiro API** credential.
2. In **Extract as Shopify section**, set the page URL and the section (Hero, Pricing, Footer...).
3. In Shopify, create a custom app with the `write_themes` scope and copy its Admin API access token. Add it as a **Header Auth** credential: name `X-Shopify-Access-Token`, value = the token.
4. In **Upload to Shopify theme**, replace `YOUR-STORE` (the part before .myshopify.com) and `YOUR-THEME-ID` (Online Store > Themes > Edit code: the number in the URL).
5. Run it, then open the theme editor and **Add section**.

Test on an unpublished theme copy first. The text and images belong to the source site: replace them with your own unless it is your site.
